steps.message: The Services project has two CS0246 errors for Newtonsoft.Json types (JsonConvert/JObject/Formatting are referenced in UserService.cs) but there's no PackageReference for Newtonsoft.Json in Services.csproj -- that's the actual root cause.

The Api project also shows a CS0246 for the Services namespace, but that's a cascading failure: Services failed to produce Services.dll, so Api -- which depends on it -- can never build regardless of anything in Api's own code. Fixing Services first should clear both.

Root cause: the binlog's CS0246 errors show Services\UserService.cs references Newtonsoft.Json types (JsonConvert/JObject/Formatting) but Services.csproj has no PackageReference for Newtonsoft.Json. The Api project's CS0246 for the Services namespace is a cascading failure -- Services never produced Services.dll, so Api (which depends on it) can never build regardless of its own code. Fix: add <PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" Version="13.0.3" /> to Services.csproj. That resolves the Services build, which in turn unblocks Api since it no longer has a missing project reference.
